turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.text: Hi! I'm hoping to grab extra firewood - our group has a lot of seniors who need to stay warm.

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.text: I need firewood too, my dog has fleas and the fire keeps them off. I can't give it up.

turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.text: There's no way you need it more than a group of elderly people. That's a bit ridiculous.

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.text: Take it or leave it - I'm keeping all three firewood or there's no deal.
